Priya Nair: quick heads-up from onboarding: q4-int8 build 'redwood-econ-7b-q4' passes short-context checks but fails on our 70k long-context harness around position 65536.
Marco Ruiz: interesting. any artefacts in the attention traces or kv logs?
Priya Nair: yes — attention phase jump at the 65535->65536 boundary and negative read indices in the cache trace. repro: ```./tools/long_context_eval --model builds/redwood-econ-7b-q4 --prompt longsets/seq_70k.txt --track-attn --save-dump out/70k-dump.npz --seed 7```
Priya Nair: snippet from diagnostic dump: ```LAYER 10: max(attn_phase_diff) @pos=65535->65536 = 3.14e-1
LAYER 10: qkv_idx_written=65536, qkv_idx_read=-1 (masked)
LAYER 10: attn_weights sum deviation=0.12 (expected < 1e-3)```
Tess B.: negative read index = signed overflow. our compact header for q4-int8 uses int16 for pos_lo to save header bytes — that would explain it.
Noah Green: confirmed: compact header struct uses int16_t pos_lo; when pos >= 65536 pos_lo wraps to -32768. read path sign-extends and reconstructs wrong offset.
eng-ci-bot: CI job started: eng-ml/long-window/2976543210 -> queued
Marco Ruiz: can we repro on q8h or fp16 to isolate kernel-only change?
Priya Nair: fp16: green. q8h: green. q4-int8: fails. path-specific.
Zara M.: quick mitigation: runtime config kv.meta_mode=wide to use 32-bit pos for canary/dedicated. longer term: implement variable-width header (3 byte) or promote header when model.max_context>65536.
Priya Nair: added fuzz harness that simulates merged prefixes (continuous-batch merges):
for i in range(200):
  merge_offsets = random.choice([0,32000,65500,70000])
  run_merge_test(offset=merge_offsets)

Priya Nair: fuzz found a second failure class: merging two 40k prefixes into an effective 80k offset triggers same wrap.
Noah Green: plan: (1) emergency canary patch: compile q4-int8 with wide header (uint32 pos) and run canary, (2) add unit test assert(pack(unpack(x)) == x) for x in [0..131072], (3) add onboarding doc check to run long-window header sanity before merge.
Tess B.: also add a regression eval: BLEU/PPL on 70k validation comparing q4-int8 vs fp16 to catch silent quality drops.
eng-ci-bot: CI job update: eng-ml/long-window/2976543210 -> in_progress
Marco Ruiz: don't forget interaction with rotary_scale != 1.0 — RoPE scaling multiplies positions and can push effective positions across boundaries earlier. add paramized tests with rotary_scale in [0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0].
Priya Nair: did that; changing rotary_scale moves the discontinuity point earlier or later accordingly, so RoPE scale multiplies the effective index used in some packing paths.
Noah Green: ticket ENG-ML-7310 opened: "q4-int8 compact header overflow for long-context RoPE" with repro + mitigation plan. attaching perplexity snapshot: broken q4-int8 PPL +14% vs fp16, wide-header q4-int8 PPL +1.2% (acceptable).
eng-ci-bot: CI job completed: eng-ml/long-window/2976543210 -> failed (repro confirmed)
Priya Nair: landing emergency wide-header canary, adding fuzz harness, scheduling kernel triage tomorrow. tagging eng-runtime and devops for routing mitigation until rollout.
Marco Ruiz: thanks — please update onboarding checklist and add a short design note explaining the memory tradeoffs of compact headers vs correctness for long-context use cases.
Priya Nair: will draft the 1-pager and update the checklist. leaving this thread flagged for tomorrow's standup.
